description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto media pipeline capabilities module. It includes mock methods for client connection management and MIME type support queries.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientConnected method to simulate a client connection event.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientDisconnected method to simulate a client disconnection event.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocks the getSupportedMimeTypes method to simulate retrieval of supported MIME types.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocks the isMimeTypeSupported method to simulate checking if a MIME type is supported.
